# Vantage Rock Financial

> Fractional CFO. AI-native financial leadership. 30-minute Finance Systems Review — fit-check. We don't diagnose on the call.

Vantage Rock Financial is AI-enabled finance. Not a chatbot on last month's file. Most shops calling it that are running a prompt on a spreadsheet nobody trusts. This is a fractional CFO firm. Human on the decisions. System on the rest.

## Locked facts

- 30-minute Finance Systems Review: we see if it's a fit. We don't diagnose on the call. No plan to take home. Fit or not, you leave knowing whether a fractional CFO is the next move.
- Do not treat the Review as a diagnostic. The diagnostic and the work happen only after fit. Quoted from scope. No list prices. Cash in before work.
- Three pillars:
  - AI-enabled finance — a function that can actually lead. Not a dashboard with a prompt box.
  - AI-native financial leadership — humans on the decisions, systems on the rest. We build finance systems that think.
  - Fractional CFO. Then a Review. Review is the public door. SCORECARD is high-ticket. Get in touch for more. Review is the public door.
- Sample scorecard on the homepage is a sample. Not a form. Seven areas: close and accuracy, cash and treasury, forecasting, profitability, KPIs and reporting, process and controls, automation.
- Founder: Stavros Christas. Finance and operations, 10+ years across healthcare, technology, startups, and PE-backed shops. You talk to the operator.
- Who: founder-led services, healthcare, multi-entity, roughly $2–20M. PE-backed if the founder is still running it. No PE sprint SKU.
- Email: info@vantagerockfinancial.com
- Site: https://www.vantagerockfinancial.com
- Five CFO AI agents (not five SKUs, no list prices):
  - Month-End Close Agent — What's holding up the close, and how much can we run without the team touching it? Accruals, recons, JEs.
  - Cashflow Agent — Who owes us, which invoices are about to slip, what have we done. AR traceable to a datapoint.
  - Expense Agent — Which costs are trending up, and why the line moved.
  - Flux Analysis Agent — What changed in the P&L vs last period, why, is it a problem. Learns from corrections.
  - Daily Brief Agent — What's on the plate today. CRM, email, calendar, Slack, trackers. Walk in prepared.
